  HIMass: Neutral Hydrogen mass from literature [M_sun]
  Total Gas Mass: Integrated gas disk mass from 3D density grid * 1.33 [M_sun]
  HIMass/Total Gas Mass: Ratio of tabular HI mass to integrated gas mass
  Total Gas Mass + TL mass: Combined integrated gas and stellar mass [M_sun]
  Total DM Mass: Integrated Dark Mass via theory formula [M_sun]
  Total DM Mass/M_b: Ratio of Dark Mass to Total Baryons
  Total DM Mass/Total Gas: Ratio of Dark Mass to Integrated Gas Mass

  Total DM Mass/Total Baryons: Ratio of Dark Mass to all baryons
